heading: The status dictionary
text:
## The status dictionary [LERR.8]

The four policies above say *how* a feature reports failure. This section
says what a failure **is**: an integer status, drawn from one registry, that
every conforming implementation shares.

The registry is `proto/status.proto#DsStatus`, and the protobuf is the
dictionary rather than a rendering of one ([STYL.2.14]). Nothing else in the
corpus assigns a status a number.
